record.offering: Productivity app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Dictation built for how you actually work. Talk to ChatGPT, prompt Claude, message your agents, reply to Slack and email, all by speaking. Aqua Voice turns speech into text in every app on your phone.

Powered by Avalon, our own transcription model, Aqua Voice is built for speed, accuracy, and the technical vocabulary that trips up other dictation apps.

HOW IT WORKS

Install the Aqua Voice keyboard. Open any app. Tap the mic and talk. Your words appear as text, ready to send.

POWERFUL VOICE EDITING

Edit mode lets you edit your last transcript, or your current selection, with your voice. For example:

"Remove filler words, this is a Slack message"
"Translate this to Japanese"
"Make this title case" / "make this lowercase"
"Spell Toni, T-O-N-I"
"Format the numbers like $10m"

BUILT FOR AI WORKFLOWS

The people using AI tools the most are doing it on the go: prompting ChatGPT from the back of an Uber, sending instructions to agents between meetings, running workflows that move faster than your thumbs can type.

Aqua Voice is the fastest way to get thoughts into any AI tool on your phone. Speak naturally, up to 230 WPM. We handle punctuation, formatting, and technical terms.

ACCURACY THAT MATTERS

Avalon is trained on the words you actually use: API endpoints, model names, programming terms, the jargon that makes generic dictation tools guess wrong. 97.3% accuracy on the AISpeak benchmark.

When 9to5Mac tested Aqua against Apple Dictation on the same passage, Apple made 17 errors. Aqua made 1.

WORKS EVERYWHERE

• ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and any AI chat
• Slack, Teams, Discord, Telegram
• iMessage, WhatsApp, Signal
• Gmail, Outlook, and every email app
• Notes, Docs, and everything else

YOUR VOICE, NOT OURS

• Personal dictionary syncs across desktop and mobile, so your names and jargon get recognized every time
• 49 languages supported
• Text starts appearing in under 50ms, final text in about 450ms
• SOC 2 Type II certified

Start free with 1,000 words. No card required.

record.description_evidence:
6x faster than typing. Zero editing required.

Wegen turns your voice into whatever you need — emails, notes, summaries, images, social posts, plans. No typing. No editing. No telling it what format you want. Just speak naturally, and Wegen's AI understands your intent and creates polished, ready-to-use content in seconds.

Stop dictating and start creating. Wegen doesn't just transcribe your words — it understands what you're trying to do and delivers the right output. Ramble about your day, and get a clean journal entry. Talk through a meeting, and get a summary with action items. Describe an image in your head, and Wegen generates it. Drop in a document, and get a concise summary in seconds.

HOW WEGEN IS DIFFERENT
Voice keyboards: You talk → you get raw text → you spend time editing.
Meeting note apps: You record 60 minutes → you get a long transcript → you search through it.
Wegen: You talk for 30 seconds → you get exactly what you need → done.

KEY FEATURES
- Intent Detection — Wegen understands what kind of content you're creating without being told. Email, summary, to-do list, social post — it just knows.
- Voice-to-Content Engine — Not transcription, but transformation. Your words become polished, structured output ready to send, share, or save.
- AI Image Generation — Describe what you see in your mind. Wegen creates it. Turn spoken ideas into visuals instantly.
- Document Summarization — Drop in a PDF, article, or document. Wegen reads it and gives you the key points fast.
- Smart Formatting — Lists, paragraphs, headers — automatically structured based on your content. No manual formatting ever.
- AI Polish — Removes filler words, fixes grammar, cleans up rambling — while keeping your natural voice.
- Translate Mode — Speak in one language, get output in another. Supports 16+ languages with automatic detection.
- One-Tap Capture — Open, speak, done. No setup, no templates, no learning curve.

BUILT FOR THE IN-BETWEEN MOMENTS
Wegen is for the 30-second to 3-minute moments where your brain is faster than your fingers:
- The post-call brain dump that becomes a clean recap with action items
- The commute email draft you send without a single edit
- The midnight idea that becomes tomorrow's structured plan
- The image you describe out loud and see generated instantly
- The 20-page report you drop in and get summarized in 30 seconds
- The voice journal entry that actually reads well

YOUR PRIVACY IS SAFE
- Voice recordings are never stored — deleted immediately after processing
- Your data is never used for model training
- No background recording — unlike voice keyboards

Make room for a daily check-in with Mirror Health, a private wellness journal with optional AI support.

Today gives you a place to begin. In Mirror, choose a guided photo, written note, quick reflection, or private one-off conversation. Find your saved photos, reflections, and guidance in Library.

KEEP A JOURNAL YOUR WAY
Save photos and notes privately. Use built-in or custom tracking categories to organize your photos. A private one-off conversation is discarded when you leave and is not added to future context.

OPTIONAL AI WITH PLUS
Plus adds optional AI observations about visible face and skin cues, a practical next step, and follow-up conversations about your photos. AI usage limits apply.

Original photos stay on your device. Before you first allow AI sharing, a disclosure explains that sending or analyzing allows OpenAI to process messages, reduced photos, wellness preferences, and recent reflection goals for AI features. You can turn off AI sharing in Settings.

Protect the app with an optional device lock. Export your history, reset AI context, or delete your data from Settings. Mirror Health has no ads. Photos and journal content are never used for advertising or analytics.

Private capture, notes, tracking categories, saved history, export, and deletion are available without Plus.

Mirror Health is for wellness reflection. It does not diagnose or treat conditions, estimate body composition, or replace professional care. AI observations can be inaccurate.

Some features require a Mirror Health Plus subscription. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in your Apple ID subscription settings. Restore Purchases is available in Settings.

Sakha (Sanskrit: सखा — "Friend") is your personal AI companion for emotional wellness and personal growth. Whether you're navigating stress, relationships, career decisions, or just need someone to listen — Sakha is here with warmth, understanding, and no judgment.

Unlike other wellness apps that offer one-size-fits-all advice, Sakha has real conversations with you. It remembers what you've shared, adapts to how you communicate, and meets you where you are.

REAL CONVERSATIONS, REAL COMFORT

Sakha isn't a chatbot that gives generic responses. It's a companion that truly listens.

• Talk About Anything — Stress at work, relationship struggles, sleepless nights, big life decisions, or just a rough day. No topic is too small or too heavy. Sakha responds with genuine understanding.

• Thoughtful Follow-ups — Sakha doesn't just reply and wait. It asks the right questions, notices patterns in what you share, and gently guides you toward clarity without being pushy.

• Available 24/7 — No appointments, no waiting rooms, no scheduling. Sakha is ready whenever you need to talk — at 2 AM after a bad dream, during a lunch break, or on a quiet Sunday evening.

SMART SUGGESTIONS

After every response, Sakha offers relevant follow-up suggestions tailored to your conversation — so you always know what to explore next. Whether it's going deeper on a topic, shifting perspective, or trying a new approach to what you're dealing with.

PERSONALIZED TO YOU

Sakha learns and adapts with every conversation:

• Communication Style — Whether you prefer direct advice, gentle nudges, or just someone to listen, Sakha adjusts its tone to match what works for you.

• Topics That Matter — Over time, Sakha understands your recurring themes — career growth, family dynamics, self-confidence, health anxiety — and brings relevant context into new conversations.

• Session History — Pick up where you left off. Your conversation threads are saved so you can revisit past insights, track your growth, or continue a deeper discussion.

• Multiple Sessions — Create separate conversations for different topics. Keep your work stress chat separate from your relationship reflections.

The more you talk to Sakha, the better it understands you. It picks up on what kind of support helps most — whether that's practical advice, emotional validation, gentle challenges, or simply being heard. Every conversation makes the next one more meaningful.

PRIVACY IS NOT A FEATURE — IT'S A PROMISE

Your conversations are deeply personal. We treat them that way.

• Encrypted — All data encrypted in transit and at rest. Your words stay between you and Sakha.
• Zero Data Selling — We never sell, share, or monetize your personal data. Period.
• Full Data Deletion — Delete your account anytime and everything goes with it. No hidden backups.
• Transparent — We're upfront about what we collect and why. No fine print surprises.

WHO IS SAKHA FOR?

• Anyone going through a tough time who needs a safe space to talk
• People navigating life transitions — new jobs, breakups, moving cities
• Those dealing with daily stress who want someone to talk to
• Anyone who wants something more personal than a generic chatbot
• People who aren't ready for therapy but need more than a self-help book

Sakha is not a replacement for professional mental health care. If you are in crisis, please reach out to a professional helpline immediately.

Sakha is your AI friend that walks beside you, not in front of you. Begin your journey today.

Aura is a private AI wellness companion for moments when life feels tangled. Talk things through, write what you feel, check in with yourself, and turn insights into small next steps.

WHAT YOU CAN DO WITH AURA

Personal Companion (AI Chat & Emotional Support)
Talk or type in a private, judgment free space. Aura listens, remembers what matters, and gets more personal over time based on what you choose to share.

Smart Journaling & Check Ins (AI Journal & Mood Reflection)
Capture thoughts and feelings with gentle prompts that help you reflect and notice patterns.

Knots Untangle (Stress Sorting)
For moments when too much is happening at once. Slow down, sort what matters, and find one small next step.

Free Thought (AI Journaling & Venting)
Let your thoughts out without pressure or direction. A calm space to express what is on your mind.

Connection Compass (Relationship Reflection)
When a relationship feels stuck, explore what you feel, what matters, and what you may want next.

Rehearsal Room (Conversation Practice)
Practice what you want to say before the real thing. Prepare for boundaries, feedback, apologies, or difficult conversations in a private space.

Blindspot (Perspective Check)
Separate what happened from what you assume happened, so you can see the situation with more space.

Pulse (Mood Check In)
A quick read on where you are right now and what you might need next.

Deep Dive Coaching (Personal Action Steps)
After a reflection or lesson, Aura helps you turn insight into practical steps that fit your real life.

Learning Library (Personal Growth Lessons)
Explore practical lessons for everyday growth, communication, productivity, self awareness, and emotional skills.

WHY AURA

• Built around you: The more you use Aura, the better it understands and supports you.
• Always available: No appointments, no waiting, no pressure.
• Expert crafted: Aura is designed with research based principles and thoughtful AI systems.
• Private by design: Your reflections stay yours and are protected.

IMPORTANT

Aura provides self help and wellness support. It is not medical or mental health care. Aura does not provide diagnosis, treatment, or emergency support. If you are in crisis or may harm yourself or others, contact local emergency services or seek immediate help.

Download Aura and start with one thought.

FABU combines a powerful mood tracker, AI habit builder, and personalized daily plan to help you grow step by step with the support of your personal Pet Care Friend.

A self-care and wellness app designed to help you track your mood, build healthy habits, and improve your daily routine.

Meet Your Pet Care Friend
At the heart of FABU is your Pet Care Friend — a supportive companion that grows with your progress.
As you track your mood, complete daily tasks, and build healthier habits, your companion evolves alongside you. Celebrate your wins together and stay motivated as your journey unfolds.

AI-Powered Habit Builder
Creating new habits can feel overwhelming. FABU simplifies the process with an AI-powered habit builder that helps you stay consistent and focused.
The app intelligently suggests tasks and routines designed around your goals, helping you gradually build habits that support your wellbeing and everyday balance.

Personalized Daily Plan
Stay consistent with a Daily Plan tailored specifically for you.
Your plan adapts to your goals, mood, and energy level, creating a clear structure for your day and helping you develop healthy routines step by step.

Mood Tracker & Emotional Insights
FABU works as a powerful mood tracker that helps you better understand your emotional patterns.
Track how you feel in a simple mood calendar and review your emotions over time. Discover what influences your mood and gain deeper insight into your wellbeing.

Support When Stress Appears
Stress and uncertainty are part of everyday life — but you don’t have to face them alone.
The Act feature offers quick grounding actions and simple self-care exercises designed to help you calm your mind and regain balance whenever you need support.

Tools for Self-Care & Personal Growth

- mood tracking and emotional insights
- AI-powered habit building
- personalized daily plans
- breathing exercises for stress relief
- positive affirmations for motivation
- progress tracking with your Pet Care Friend

Reflectly is a journaling app that's like your best friend. Vent your thoughts & feelings to improve your mood and practice mindfulness. Write down how you feel each day in your own mood diary — an intelligent journal & mood tracker that gives you personalized prompts and motivation the more you use it.
 
THE BEST JOURNAL APP FOR SELF-CARE AND MINDFULNESS
 
How you’re feeling on a daily basis matters. Reflectly is a personal journal driven by AI to help you deal with negative thoughts and increase positivity.
 
Be prepared for stress relief, reducing anxiety & depression in your life. Your self-care and mental health should always be a priority.
 
Reflectly uses positive psychology, mindfulness, and cognitive behavioral therapy (cbt) to help you thrive. It gives you the tools and mindset to build a positive cycle with our habit tracker. Fancy a bit of self-dating? Reflectly supports your self-love journey.
 
Never journaled before? No need to worry, our intelligent journal system gives you personalized prompts and reminders. If you want to build a health-focused lifestyle, increase motivation & gratitude, practice mindfulness, or combat anxiety, our personalized questions encourage deeper reflection. 
 
RECOMMENDED BY PROFESSIONALS
 
Journaling is a respected method to improve your mood, productivity, and mental health. Psychologists, therapists, and industry experts reaffirm this. It’s time to invest in your self-care routine.
 
HOW REFLECTLY WORKS
 
• Write down how you feel each day. Morning daily motivation quotes & challenges, evening daily insights, and whenever you need to vent.
• Using AI & smart tech, Reflectly’s mood tracker helps by showing you mood correlations and graphs. Been stressed for the last 10 days and can’t pin-point why? Reflectly has answers.
• We ask personalized questions based on your diary entries so you can reflect deeper.
• Read or edit previous journal entries.
• Receive daily, weekly, and monthly overviews with personalized insights and reminders.
 
REVIEWS
 
- "It’s a really amazing app. It’s the one app I go to write about my feelings and how my day was :) I really recommend this app to ANYONE."
- "I love that this app lets me keep all my entries to read later. I also love that it gives some direction for people like me who want to journal but don’t know where to start."
 
REFLECTLY PREMIUM
 
Unlock Reflectly and become your own hero.
 
• Create unlimited stories in your personal planner
• Get a new question and reminder each day to help you reflect
• Unlock advanced statistics, actionable insights, and much more!
 
Reflectly offers auto-renewing subscriptions. Pricing is shown in the app before you purchase and varies by region.
 
After free trial, the total amount for the subscription will be charged to your iTunes Account. The subscription automatically renews unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal at the total subscription price within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. Subscriptions and auto-renewals may be managed or canceled via your iTunes Account settings. Any unused portion of free trial is forfeited after purchase. Special introductory offers only apply to first billing term.

• https://kodeon.ai/terms-of-use

record.offering: Education app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Want to use AI at work and in your own projects, but don't know where to start?
→ WellEarn gives you a clear, step-by-step plan and short lessons that fit into a few minutes a day.

This app is for WellEarn learners. Sign in with your WellEarn account to follow your personal learning plan, take lessons and practice with AI wherever you are. Your progress is saved to your account, so you can switch between your phone and the web at any time.

What's inside

- Personal learning plan
A guided path from AI basics to using AI in real work: the key tools, prompts that get results, delivering work to clients, building a portfolio and marketing yourself. Along the way you pick a practical track, such as Canva templates, Notion templates, digital planners, print-on-demand or AI services.

- Short, interactive lessons
Each lesson reveals one step at a time, with quizzes, real-life scenarios, "spot the error" exercises and side-by-side examples. You learn by doing, not just by reading.

- Hands-on AI tasks
Practice right inside the lesson: match pairs, put steps in the right order, complete a prompt, or write your own prompt and get feedback from AI.

- Academy
Courses on the AI tools people use at work, including ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Midjourney, plus courses on earning online, marketing and sales, content creation and remote work. Day-by-day challenges help you build the habit.

- AI chat
Ask questions, brainstorm ideas and test your prompts with ChatGPT, Gemini or Claude. Attach a photo, switch models and come back to past chats at any time.

Who is WellEarn for?
- Beginners who want a simple, structured start with AI
- Freelancers and creators who want to work faster with AI tools
- Professionals who want practical AI skills for everyday work

Good to know
- Sign in with the email and password of your existing WellEarn account.
- Forgot your password? Reset it from the sign-in screen.
- Questions or feedback? Write to support@wellearn.io.

Learn AI step by step, a few minutes a day, with WellEarn.
